facts.content: Hundreds or even thousands of classes may be created. Classes should be organized into packages. Base package for a Java project is the domain name of your company in reverse. Example base package: come.codewithmosh for website codewithmosh.com. You do not need an actual registered domain; the reverse domain is just a namespace. Every class created in the project will belong to this package. Packages will be discussed in more detail later. Prompt to type a base package for your project.
